title: Tadokoro-san
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy high-school student Kageko Tadokoro spends class drawing and is mocked by classmates for her art and appearance. Popular, clever Sakurako Nikaido is infatuated with her after seeing her drawings, and when Tadokoro offers to draw her portrait, Nikaido hopes to get closer to the girl she is obsessed with.
life_message: It suggests that being truly seen and loved for one's art and self can outweigh the mockery of others.
